principle: A station/base assignment is a first-class Starfleet career assignment, not merely a menu location between ship missions.
rules: Facility assignments use the same rank/position/department separation as ship assignments.
Being assigned to a facility does not automatically grant command authority over visiting ships.
Facility personnel can receive local, regional and support missions without being part of a starship crew.
Temporary duty and transfers between ship and facility assignments are supported.
Career progression may include facility service without treating it as inferior to starship service.
